headlines.title: 주택가격전망 CSI, 4년 10개월 만 최고치
headlines.summary: [서울=뉴시스] 최동준 기자 = 집값 오름세가 지속되면서 주택가격전망지수(CSI)가 4년 10개월 만에 최고 수준으로 상승했다. 28일 한국은행이 발표한 '7월 소비자동향조사'에 따르면 소비자심리지수(CCSI)는 전월(106.6)보다 0.2포인트 오른 106.8이다. 주택가격전망CSI는 전월(120)보다 7포인트 상승한 127이다.

key_headlines.title: Capital Gains Tax Reform: 1 Billion Won Ceiling on Long-Term Holding Deduction
key_headlines.summary: The government is finalizing real estate tax reforms that would cap the long-term holding deduction at 1 billion won with maximum 80% deduction rates for residence periods. The policy aims to control housing prices through taxation rather than supply increases.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse Crisis Spreads Beyond Apartments to Villas and Non-Apartment Housing
key_headlines.summary: The jeonse (key money deposit) crisis that began in the apartment market is now expanding to villas and other non-apartment housing, with renewal contract rates dropping to 36% and prices rising sharply. The government is pushing quick supply measures to address the crisis.

key_headlines.title: Reverse Trading Surges 596% in Six Months as Elderly Investors Face Market Collapse
key_headlines.summary: Forced liquidations through reverse trading jumped from 56.5 billion won in January to 393.5 billion won in June, with investors aged 70 and above experiencing a 791% increase. Half-year forced liquidations reached 1 trillion won as stock market volatility impacts older retail investors.

key_headlines.title: Stock Market Circuit Breakers Triggered: KOSPI Falls 10.84%, KOSDAQ Down 7.72%
key_headlines.summary: Korean stock markets experienced sharp declines with simultaneous circuit breaker activations on semiconductor stocks, particularly Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. KOSPI closed at 6023.66 and KOSDAQ fell 7.72% amid global AI-related concerns.

key_headlines.title: Korea to Invest 19.8 Billion Dollars in Texas Natural Gas Power Plant as First Major US Investment
key_headlines.summary: The Korean government is considering building a gas-fired power plant in Texas with 19.8 billion dollar investment as its flagship US project, prioritizing profitability given surging electricity demand from AI data centers.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government is actively pursuing comprehensive real estate reforms focusing on taxation rather than supply expansion, with capital gains tax ceilings and enhanced holding taxes under review. The jeonse (key money) crisis is spreading beyond apartments to villas and other non-apartment housing, threatening broader market stability and prompting government emergency supply measures. Consumer housing price expectations have reached their highest level in five years despite regulatory tightening, indicating strong market sentiment. Meanwhile, reverse trading and forced liquidations are surging dramatically, particularly among elderly investors, with half-year forced liquidations reaching 1 trillion won as stock market volatility intensifies.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is restructuring the basic income calculation methodology for welfare benefits, with the standard median income for a four-member household set to increase 6.7% to 6.92 million won next year, marking a record high. The new calculation method incorporates consumer price indices, real GDP growth rates, and relative poverty alleviation measures alongside household financial survey data. Budget officials are engaging in unprecedented high-level discussions with both major labor unions about surplus tax distribution, signaling the government's focus on fiscal balancing and welfare sustainability. The basic livelihood security allowance for four-member households will increase to 2.217 million won, reflecting the government's commitment to supporting vulnerable populations amid economic uncertainties.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets experienced severe volatility with simultaneous circuit breaker activations on both KOSPI and KOSDAQ, with KOSPI plummeting 10.84% and KOSDAQ falling 7.72% amid semiconductor sector collapse. The government announced plans to publicly disclose low-PBR (price-to-book ratio) companies starting November, targeting the bottom 25% of KOSPI and bottom 10% of KOSDAQ that maintain poor valuations for three consecutive years. Options premium on KOSPI200 has surged to 2.6% of the index value, reflecting heightened market volatility and investor hedging demand. Covered call ETFs are gaining traction among retail investors seeking income from the volatile market environment.
sections.Industry & Technology: Solid-state batteries, considered the dream battery technology, are expected to first commercialize in drone and robot markets before entering electric vehicle applications, marking a significant shift in technology deployment strategy. The semiconductor industry faces challenges from Chinese competition and AI-related market concerns, with analysts drawing parallels to Germany's automotive industry decline amid disruptive technology shifts. Investment timelines for renewable energy infrastructure show solar power requiring only 220 days (0.6 years) from investment decision to commercial operation, compared to much longer periods for nuclear power. The government is reconsidering its nuclear phase-out policy, recognizing the need for stable baseload power to support growing electricity demand from AI data centers and renewable energy integration challenges.
sections.Real Estate: Consumer sentiment on future housing prices has reached its highest level in five years despite government regulatory tightening, with the housing price expectation consumer sentiment index rising to 127. The government is implementing multi-pronged real estate strategies including tax reforms, enhanced corporate rental housing programs, and redevelopment projects in secondary cities like Daejeon and Gwacheon. Government statistics show significant regional disparities, with some Daejeon properties remaining at the same price for 16 years while official data indicates 55% appreciation, highlighting measurement and regional equity concerns.
